headline: PROP's MK jumps 14.55% on heavy volume, while AQUA and SQ each gap up 11.11% at open.
market_take: Multiple sectors posted strong single‑day gains, led by PROP, FOOD and CONS with several stocks above 5% and volume spikes. The 5‑day leaderboard shows TTCL and GEL soaring 33.3% each, offset by PF and XBIO falling over 14%. Unusual‑trading alerts highlight price gaps for AQUA, SQ and MK, and a notable volume surge for MADAME, which also disclosed a new joint‑venture.

sector_notes.note: AQUA posted an 11.11% open‑gap and SST rose 7.37% intraday; MADAME saw a 3.8σ volume spike and filed a joint‑venture announcement. TU disclosed a loan arrangement and ITC reported a related‑party transaction.
MK surged 14.55% with a 6.8σ volume spike; JCK fell 7.69% on an open gap. ESTAR, EVER and CGD each recorded sizable price gaps and intraday moves, while AKS faces a court‑ordered receivership.
SQ and DEMCO both gap up 11.11% and 8.57% respectively, with DEMCO also filing a capital increase. Several mid‑caps (STPI, CK, SEAFCO, APCS, STECON) posted 5‑6% gains.
EPG rose 6.25% and DCON opened +5.56%; SKN logged a 7.3σ volume spike. GEL experienced a -25.00% price gap but rebounded +33.33% intraday, contributing to its 5‑day +33.3% gain.
M‑PAT advanced 6.00%; CPNCG announced a capital reduction, reflecting ongoing restructuring in the REIT space.
TFM recorded a 4.6σ volume spike, while no filing was linked to the alert.
